description: Get a summary of hours logged for a user or team over a date range

end_date.description: End date for the summary period (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-31)

scope.description: Scope of the summary: 'user' for individual user hours, 'team' for organization-wide overview. Defaults to 'user'.

start_date.description: Start date for the summary period (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01)

name: get_hours_summary
